Package neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram

Class ScdDiagramRenderer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram.ScdDiagramRenderer
public final class ScdDiagramRenderer extends Object
A3 System Control Diagram function sheets using the native PFD/P&ID SVG/PDF scene writers.

Named signal continuations preserve arbitrary feedback and cross-equipment graphs without ambiguous wire crossings. Each continuation appears at both ends with the same signal identity. Equipment/line context, project system assignment, template code and terminal designations come from the shared source model.

Version:
1.0
